description: Backend: Extend User model, create profile.service.js and profile.controller.js with all enterprise profile APIs - 2FA (TOTP setup/verify/disable/backup codes), active sessions, login activity, online presence middleware, notification preferences, connected cloud accounts, security activity timeline, data export, and account deletion. Add new validations and extend profile.routes.js.
steps: 1. EXTEND the User model (backend/src/models/user.model.js) to add these fields alongside existing ones (do NOT remove/rename any existing fields): bio (String, max 500), phone (String), country (String), timezone (String), jobTitle (String), twoFactorSecret (String, private:true, default null), twoFactorEnabled (Boolean, default false), twoFactorBackupCodes ([{code: String, used: Boolean}], private:true, default []), lastSeenAt (Date, default null), notificationPreferences ({emailNotifications: Boolean default true, securityAlerts: Boolean default true, deploymentNotifications: Boolean default true, monitoringAlerts: Boolean default true, marketingEmails: Boolean default false}), connectedAccounts ([{provider: String enum ['aws','azure','gcp'], accountId: String, region: String, connectedAt: Date, status: String enum ['connected','disconnected']}]).
2. Add 'otpauth' and 'qrcode' to backend/package.json optionalDependencies (otpauth ^9.2.0, qrcode ^1.5.3). These will be dynamically imported with try/catch fallback.

3. Create backend/src/services/profile.service.js with these methods (all follow the existing authService pattern of throwing ApiError and recording audit logs): (a) updateExtendedProfile(userId, {name,organization,bio,phone,country,timezone,jobTitle}, context) - updates user fields, records audit. (b) setup2FA(userId, context) - generates TOTP secret using dynamic import('otpauth'), creates otpauth URI, generates QR code data URL using dynamic import('qrcode'), stores encrypted secret in user.twoFactorSecret, returns {qrCodeUrl, secret, backupCodes}. Generate 10 backup codes (crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')). (c) verify2FA(userId, {token}, context) - verifies TOTP token against stored secret, sets twoFactorEnabled=true if valid, records audit. (d) disable2FA(userId, {currentPassword}, context) - verifies password, clears 2FA fields, records audit. (e) getBackupCodes(userId) - returns user's backup codes. (f) regenerateBackupCodes(userId, context) - generates new backup codes, stores, records audit, returns new codes. (g) getActiveSessions(userId) - queries Token model for user's non-blacklisted refresh tokens (these represent active sessions), returns array of {id, createdAt, expiresAt, current: boolean}. (h) revokeSession(userId, tokenId, context) - deletes specific token by _id + user match, records audit. (i) revokeAllOtherSessions(userId, currentTokenHash, context) - revokes all user refresh tokens EXCEPT the current one, records audit. (j) getLoginActivity(userId, {page,limit}) - queries AuditLog model for actor=userId, action='login', sorted by createdAt desc with pagination. Returns entries with ip, userAgent, createdAt, success fields. (k) getSecurityActivity(userId, {page,limit}) - queries AuditLog for actor=userId with actions in ['login','logout','update','create','delete'], descriptions matching security events, paginated. (l) updateNotificationPreferences(userId, prefs, context) - updates user.notificationPreferences, records audit. (m) getConnectedAccounts(userId) - returns user.connectedAccounts array. (n) connectCloudAccount(userId, {provider,accountId,region}, context) - adds/updates entry in connectedAccounts array, records audit. (o) disconnectCloudAccount(userId, provider, context) - sets status to 'disconnected' for the given provider entry, records audit. (p) exportProfileData(userId) - returns full user profile as JSON object (excluding password and twoFactorSecret raw value). (q) deleteAccount(userId, {currentPassword}, context) - verifies password, revokes all tokens, soft-deletes user (set isActive=false, email to 'deleted_'+id+'@deleted.local'), records audit.

4. Create backend/src/controllers/profile.controller.js with thin controller handlers following the existing auth.controller.js pattern (asyncHandler, reqContext, sendSuccess): updateExtendedProfile, setup2FA, verify2FA, disable2FA, getBackupCodes, regenerateBackupCodes, getActiveSessions, revokeSession, revokeAllOtherSessions, getLoginActivity, getSecurityActivity, updateNotificationPreferences, getConnectedAccounts, connectCloudAccount, disconnectCloudAccount, exportProfileData, deleteAccount.

5. Extend backend/src/validations/profile.validation.js: Add new validation chains: updateExtendedProfileValidation (name optional 2-80, organization optional max 120, bio optional max 500, phone optional matches phone regex, country optional max 80, timezone optional max 100, jobTitle optional max 100), verify2FAValidation (token required string 6 digits), disable2FAValidation (currentPassword required), updateNotificationPrefsValidation (emailNotifications optional boolean, securityAlerts optional boolean, deploymentNotifications optional boolean, monitoringAlerts optional boolean, marketingEmails optional boolean), connectCloudAccountValidation (provider required enum aws/azure/gcp, accountId required string, region required string), deleteAccountValidation (currentPassword required string).

6. Extend backend/src/routes/profile.routes.js: Keep ALL existing routes untouched. Add new routes below them: PUT /extended (updateExtendedProfile with validation), POST /2fa/setup (setup2FA), POST /2fa/verify (verify2FA with validation), POST /2fa/disable (disable2FA with validation + authLimiter), GET /2fa/backup-codes (getBackupCodes), POST /2fa/backup-codes/regenerate (regenerateBackupCodes), GET /sessions (getActiveSessions), DELETE /sessions/:id (revokeSession), DELETE /sessions (revokeAllOtherSessions), GET /login-activity (getLoginActivity), GET /security-activity (getSecurityActivity), PUT /notifications (updateNotificationPreferences with validation), GET /cloud-accounts (getConnectedAccounts), POST /cloud-accounts (connectCloudAccount with validation), DELETE /cloud-accounts/:provider (disconnectCloudAccount), GET /export (exportProfileData), DELETE /account (deleteAccount with validation + authLimiter). Import profileController instead of authController for new routes.

7. Create backend/src/middleware/presence.js: Export a middleware function that updates user.lastSeenAt = new Date() on every authenticated request. Use User.updateOne({_id: req.user.id}, {lastSeenAt: new Date()}) without await (fire-and-forget to avoid slowing requests). Import this in backend/src/routes/profile.routes.js and apply AFTER authenticate but as a general middleware on the router (router.use(updatePresence) after router.use(authenticate)).

8. Update backend/src/config/constants.js: Add new AUDIT_ACTIONS entries: ENABLE_2FA: 'enable_2fa', DISABLE_2FA: 'disable_2fa', SESSION_REVOKED: 'session_revoked'. Add to AUDIT_ACTION_VALUES. Also update the auditLog.model.js enum reference if needed (the enum uses AUDIT_ACTION_VALUES from constants.js so it should auto-include).
9. Update backend/src/models/index.js - no changes needed since User model is already exported there.
10. Verify: Read all new/modified files to confirm ESM imports, ApiError usage, asyncHandler wrapping, and pattern consistency.
acceptance_criteria: User model has all new fields (bio, phone, country, timezone, jobTitle, twoFactorSecret, twoFactorEnabled, twoFactorBackupCodes, lastSeenAt, notificationPreferences, connectedAccounts)
backend/src/routes/profile.routes.js has all new routes while keeping existing routes intact
backend/src/middleware/presence.js exists and exports updatePresence middleware
otpauth and qrcode are in backend/package.json optionalDependencies
2FA methods use dynamic import() with try/catch for otpauth and qrcode
All new code uses ESM imports, asyncHandler, ApiError, sendSuccess patterns
verification: Read all created/modified backend files to verify valid JavaScript ESM syntax
Verify imports are consistent and reference existing modules correctly
Verify profile.routes.js still has original 5 routes plus new ones
Verify dynamic imports use try/catch pattern consistent with cloud-adapters
findings: All files pass Node.js syntax check (--check). Cannot run full npm test/build due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. Node preload script (proxy-bootstrap.js) fails in this sandbox but is unrelated to code - must use NODE_OPTIONS='' to run node --check. OTPAuth dynamic imports use try/catch consistent with cloud-adapters pattern.
